LESSON: EXPLORING WEATHER

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and 1.1 Weather and Sky By the end of the sub-strand,  Learners to 
Topic 1.1.2: Exploring weather

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Exploring weather. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How is the weather today?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe
   In simple words: practise until you can identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Exploring weather using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Exploring weather in the examples.
2. Explain Exploring weather to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Exploring weather.
4. Show that you can: identify weather (windy, cloudy, rainy and sunny) conditions of the day  In groups, learners to observe

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Exploring weather using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Exploring weather important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, learners to observe b) make reasonable weather weather conditions of the day in forecast of the day the immediate environment c) appreciate weather
2. Share experiences conditions at different about daily weather conditions times of the day.
3. Identify various weather conditions of a day using age appropriate stimulus materials
4. Mime various weather conditions for enjoyment 63
5. Find out more about the sky during the day and at night from parents or guardians.

SECTION: REMEMBER
